scope: read-only installed npm package namespace, root bin launcher contents, and npm installed lock identity
limits: All observed source, launcher and lock bytes remain under broad-write H: ancestors; the combined fingerprint is only change-detection evidence, not trusted publisher or registry attestation.

Only physical node_modules files inside this installed package root were inventoried. Dynamic imports from elsewhere, globally installed packages, browser/PDF cache/downloads, external helpers and active process modules are not exhaustively qualified.
Recursive metadata traversal and best-effort lstat/fstat checks are not atomic race-free Windows file-handle or namespace attestation.
An installed npm command launcher is not itself proof the production manager invokes it; the future protected-root design must qualify command/spawn paths before moving or enabling DEV.

Source acceptance of draft PR45 requires genuinely executed and independently verified hosted Windows/Linux tests and then actual-main post-merge qualification, currently blocked by GitHub Actions account admission.
Actual restricted MTermDev account, protected ACL parents, canary access tests, separate DEV credentials/routes, recovery and rollback require separate specific operational owner approval.
